<description>
While background validation runs after loading an assumeutxo
snapshot, blocks needed only by the background (historical) chainstate
are also tracked in mapBlocksInFlight. The condition that decides
whether a new block is requested as a compact block counted those
blocks as well, so with historical blocks in flight the new block at
the tip was requested as a full block instead.

Do not count blocks that are only needed by the historical chainstate.
Compact block relay then works normally during background validation.

Behavior is unchanged when no snapshot is loaded, because in that case
there are no historical blocks to exclude.
</description>

<commits>
47ffe1630f p2p: ignore historical blocks when counting blocks in flight

While background validation runs after loading an assumeutxo
snapshot, blocks needed only by the background (historical) chainstate
are also tracked in mapBlocksInFlight. The condition that decides
whether a compact block can be processed counted those blocks as well,
so it did not behave as it does on a node without a snapshot.

Do not count blocks that are only needed by the historical chainstate.
Compact block relay then works normally during background validation.

Behavior is unchanged when no snapshot is loaded, because in that case
there are no historical blocks to exclude.

a695d65fda test: request tip block as compact while historical blocks are in flight
</commits>
